text:
emma: Quick PR heads-up  updating hello-minimal quickstart to use refresh tokens + short-lived access tokens. Need someone to sanity-check snippets.

rafael: happy to review. which snippets change?

emma: auth exchange, client init examples (js/python), deploy CLI model id -> use redwood/gpt-3.5-mini, and change port fallback to PORT || 8081. also fix one broken anchor to /docs/auth#token-rotation.

nina: can you add a tiny curl example for the token exchange? ops folks like that.

emma: added curl and a Go example. small security blurb about storing refresh tokens in secret manager and rotating them.

docs-bot: PR opened by emma: #2512  lint ok, linkcheck found 1 anchor (fixed).

rafael: quick nit: in JS example use `RedwoodClient({ accessToken })` not `apiKey`. also show async/await pattern.

emma: updated. build-bot: preview available at staging.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-minimal  render ok.

nina: lgtm from me, minor spacing comment in code.

rafael: approving.

docs-bot: PR #2512 merged by emma  site published.

emma: thanks all  will follow up with a short migration checklist for self-hosted customers.
